Container.Name: MinePanel
Container.Overview: MinePanel — An all-in-one Minecraft server management panel for Unraid. Manage Java and Bedrock servers, view real-time console logs, and monitor resource usage from a single SvelteKit-powered web UI. Powered by Docker (Dockerode), SQLite, and s6-overlay.

Config.Name: Sidecar WebSocket Port
Config.Description: WebSocket port for real-time logs and stats (used internally or if not behind a reverse proxy)

Config.Name: Data Directory
Config.Description: Persistent data directory for the SQLite database, server configurations, and backups

Config.Name: Docker Socket
Config.Description: Docker socket — required to manage Minecraft server containers

Config.Name: Base Port
Config.Description: Starting port for server port block allocation. Each server gets BASE_PORT + N*PORT_BLOCK_SIZE

Config.Name: Port Block Size
Config.Description: Number of ports reserved per server (game + RCON + voice chat)
